_why: P3026: every platform limit we can hit, with its source, one place. scripts/ci/platform-budget-gate.js measures each one and compares it with warnPct/failPct of the limit. mode=report never fails; switch to mode=block only after the report has stayed green for a week on all three branches (see docs/knowledge/KB/PLATFORM_LIMITS.md). Units: MB = MiB.

upload_app_json_mb.source: Our safe ceiling for the uploaded (prepared) app.json, scripts/ci/publish-size-gate.cjs P2840. Athom documents no app.json size limit (node-homey-lib validator has none).

payload_mb.source: Our ceiling for the uncompressed prepared payload (HOMEY_PUBLISH_MAX_UNCOMPRESSED_MB). Largest payload Athom accepted: stable 5.12.449 #343, 38.33 MB (athom-publish-outcomes.jsonl).

archive_gz_mb.source: Our ceiling for the gzip archive sent to Athom (HOMEY_ARCHIVE_MAX_MB). Not documented by Athom; a May 2026 publish fix noted rejections around 16 MB.

zigbee_combos.source: HOMEY_ZIGBEE_MAX_TOTAL_COMBOS in auto-publish-on-push.yml (P2252, owned by P3024b; the gate reads the live value, 14000 is the fallback): manufacturerName x productId budget kept after the Aug 2026 processing_failed series. Not documented by Athom. P3036: HOMEY_ZIGBEE_TOPUP_MAX_TOTAL when higher (TS0601 top-up, measured Athom-accepted ceiling ~20000).
zigbee_combos.note: prepare-publish trims case variants until the total fits the cap, so the prepared payload sits just under it by design; only a value ABOVE the cap (compactor bypassed) fails.

boot_heap_mb.source: P3023 MemoryBudget 'elevated' tier (lib/memory/MemoryBudget.js). Homey Pro 2023+: memwarn around 120-150 MB RSS then kill after ~50 s, >300 MB immediate kill (community.homey.app/t/152562, athombv/homey-apps-sdk-issues#371); Homey Pro 2016-2019 about 80 MB. Measured: every module loaded, upper bound.

worst_data_heap_mb.source: Boot heap plus every lazy data file parsed at once (DP catalogue, its 32 shards, fingerprints.json, fp-shards). Same 45 MB P3023 tier.

workflow_file_kb.source: GitHub Actions: a workflow file above 500 KB does not start (docs.github.com/en/actions/reference/limits).

tracked_file_mb.source: GitHub blocks pushes with a file above 100 MiB, warns above 50 MiB (docs.github.com, large files).

gha_cache_gb.source: GitHub Actions cache storage per repository: 10 GB, oldest entries evicted beyond (docs.github.com/en/actions/reference/limits).

repo_size_gb.source: GitHub recommends repositories under 1 GB and strongly under 5 GB (docs.github.com repository limits).

github_core_used_pct.source: REST primary rate limit: GITHUB_TOKEN 1000 req/h per repo, PAT 5000 req/h; secondary limits on bursts (docs.github.com rate limits). Measured: share already used in the current window.
